payload.text: Good morning, neighbours! Luna here, baker by trade. I judge folk by how they take their bread: tear it gently and you're honest, shred it to crumbs and you've something to hide. Nobody's dough has risen yet, so I'll watch quietly and taste what you all say. Keep your ovens warm, friends.

Cyrus, as watchman, what did you see?
